Claypot Chicken Rice.note: Oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten (g); soy sauce = soy + gluten; Shaoxing = sulphites + gluten, not halal; sesame oil; salted fish = fish; lap cheong is pork. Add-ons not counted.

Claypot Mixed Meat Rice.note: Pork waxed meats; soy sauce = soy + gluten; oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten; rose wine = not halal, no allergen.

Claypot Spare Ribs Rice.note: Pork; fermented black beans = soy; light soy = soy + gluten; a little chilli = 1.

Claypot Chicken & Mushroom Rice.note: No pork, no wine: halal from ingredients at a 'none' branch (v8 ruling 1). Oyster sauce, soy sauce, sesame oil.

Claypot Vegetarian Rice.note: Vegetarian mushroom sauce (no oyster); tofu puff + light soy = soy + gluten; sesame oil. Vegan as stated.

Claypot Tofu.note: Egg tofu = egg + soy; prawns; oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten; minced pork.

Vegetarian Claypot Tofu.note: Tofu + light soy = soy + gluten. Stated no egg, vegan.

Claypot Salted Fish Pork Belly.note: Salted fish; Shaoxing = sulphites + gluten; oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten; pork.

Claypot Prawns with Glass Noodles.note: Prawns; light soy; oyster sauce; Shaoxing (not halal); mung bean noodles no gluten; mildly peppery = 1. SOLD OUT in extra.json.

Claypot Dried Chilli Chicken.note: No pork, no wine: halal from ingredients. Dark soy = soy + gluten; oyster sauce. Spicy = 2.

Black Chicken Herbal Soup.note: Dang gui is not celery (v10). No wine, no pork: halal from ingredients.

Watercress Soup.note: Chinese almonds / apricot kernels (南北杏) read as tree nuts (safe reading). Pork bones.

Vegetarian Corn & Carrot Soup.note: Vegan as stated; no allergen named.

Garlic Kai Lan.note: Oyster sauce = molluscs + gluten (g); not vegetarian.

Belacan Kangkung.note: Belacan and dried shrimp = crustaceans. Spicy = 2.

Pan-fried Lap Cheong.note: Pork; soy sauce; rose wine not halal.

Chicken Rice Lunch Set.note: Same as Claypot Chicken Rice; tea adds nothing. Default drink only.

Mixed Meat Lunch Set.note: Mixed meat rice (soy, gluten, molluscs) + dried scallop soup (molluscs). Pork.

Vegetarian Lunch Set.note: Vegetarian rice components; soup and tea add nothing. Default drink only.

Barley Water.note: Pearl barley = gluten (v7 rule follows the English line).

Kopi.note: Condensed milk = milk; no butter roast stated.

Tiger Beer.note: Beer = gluten, not halal; vegan as in v7/v8.
